name: Agentic Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [ '1.22' ]
        node-version: [ '20' ]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache: true

      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Cache Node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - name: Install Go dependencies
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Run Go tests with coverage
        run: go test ./... -v -coverprofile=coverage.out

      - name: Run Go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.61
          args: --timeout=5m

      - name: Build Go binaries
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON Schema
        run: |
          npm install -g ajv-cli
          ajv compile -s docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Run JavaScript tests
        run: npm test
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Run custom spec validation
        run: |
          if [ -f scripts/validate-spec.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/validate-spec.sh
          else
            echo "No spec validation script found."
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload test coverage
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.out
